pvIntelligence.heroSubtitle: Beyond showing numbers — AI that makes you earn more
pvIntelligence.heroDesc: Conventional monitoring systems only display generation numbers. PV Intelligence goes further: AI detects anomalies, diagnoses causes, recommends actions, and calculates loss amounts. Proven at Ninewatt's own solar plants.
pvIntelligence.problemDesc: Does your current monitoring system have these issues?
problemItems: It shows generation numbers but never explains why output dropped.
When something goes wrong, you have to visit the site in person to check.
Operating multiple plants? There's no way to compare which one has the problem.
You can't tell if a drop is due to weather or equipment failure.
Without knowing the loss amount, you can't judge how urgent it is.
pvIntelligence.diffSubtitle: Not just monitoring — your AI operations partner

diffItems.title: AI Anomaly Detection + Root Cause Analysis + Action Guidance
diffItems.desc: Not just alerts — it tells you "why output dropped, what to do, and how much you'll lose if you don't act."

diffItems.title: Multi-Site Cross Comparison
diffItems.desc: Same day, same region, but only one site drops? It's not weather — it's equipment. An independent detection method that doesn't rely on weather data alone.

diffItems.title: 3D Map-Based Multi-Site Dashboard
diffItems.desc: See all your plants on a map at a glance. Normal/Warning/Critical status identified instantly through color coding and pulse animations.

diffItems.title: Revenue Optimization Recommendations
diffItems.desc: SMP/REC sell timing, self-consumption rate optimization, curtailment subsidy maximization, panel cleaning ROI analysis — AI suggests concrete ways to increase revenue.

diffItems.title: Proven with Our Own Plants
diffItems.desc: "AI prevented ₩XX million in monthly losses" — verified results from Ninewatt's own solar plants (5–10 sites, ~100kW each), available as documented proof.

pvIntelligence.howItWorksSubtitle: Fully automated pipeline from on-site inverters to AI analysis

howItWorksSteps.title: Data Collection
howItWorksSteps.desc: Our proprietary RTU (LTE Cat.M1) transmits inverter data to the cloud every 5 minutes. Supports major brands including Hyosung, Huawei, and Hyundai via RS-485 Modbus.

howItWorksSteps.title: Cross-Comparison Analysis
howItWorksSteps.desc: Compares capacity-to-output ratios across all sites for the same time window. Sites falling below -20%p from the median are automatically flagged as anomaly candidates.

howItWorksSteps.title: AI Root Cause Analysis
howItWorksSteps.desc: When an anomaly is detected, AI synthesizes weather data, per-inverter output, and historical patterns to estimate the cause and provide natural language action guidance.

howItWorksSteps.title: Loss Calculation & Alerts
howItWorksSteps.desc: Automatically calculates daily/monthly estimated loss amounts and sends instant alerts via KakaoTalk (with SMS fallback).

pvIntelligence.aiDetectionSubtitle: Here's how PV Intelligence catches the problems that actually happen in the field.

aiDetectionScenarios.situation: One out of seven plants just stopped producing
aiDetectionScenarios.what: The other six are running fine, but the Cheongna warehouse site has been at 13% efficiency since morning. It's not the weather.
aiDetectionScenarios.action: AI flags a likely grid interconnection issue and recommends checking the MCCB. Left alone, that's roughly ₩1.38M lost per month.

aiDetectionScenarios.situation: One inverter keeps dropping output every afternoon
aiDetectionScenarios.what: Mornings are fine, but from 2 PM onward inverter #2 loses 30% output. The site next door is unaffected.
aiDetectionScenarios.action: Hourly cross-comparison pinpoints afternoon shading or string contamination as likely causes, and tells you exactly what to check on-site.

aiDetectionScenarios.situation: Revenue is quietly shrinking and nobody noticed
aiDetectionScenarios.what: Day to day it looks normal, but over the past month average efficiency across all sites has slipped 3%p.
aiDetectionScenarios.action: Flags that panel cleaning is overdue, and shows that spending ₩150K on cleaning could recover about ₩530K/month in lost revenue.

sharedEss.heroDesc: A new ESS business model that connects large-scale energy storage to the distribution grid at a single site, enabling multiple remote consumers to benefit from electricity cost savings through virtual net metering while providing grid stabilization when needed.
sharedEss.backgroundDesc: The Seoul metropolitan area (Gyeonggi Province) faces insufficient power supply relative to high electricity demand, and grid expansion is difficult due to public acceptance issues. Demand-side ESS deployment has stalled due to lack of policies and low economic viability.

backgroundItems.title: Concentrated power demand
backgroundItems.desc: Gyeonggi Yongin cluster alone forecasts 14.7GW demand by 2053. National peak demand expected to reach 202.0GW by 2051

backgroundItems.title: Grid expansion difficulties
backgroundItems.desc: Major transmission line construction delayed 66–150 months due to public acceptance issues

backgroundItems.title: Lack of demand-side ESS
backgroundItems.desc: New installation market disappeared after special rate expiration in 2019. Utilization of existing ESS also remains low

sharedEss.nwasDesc: A compensation system that pays operators who provide technology to replace or defer new distribution line construction under short-term, intermittent conditions, covering costs for the period the line construction was avoided or delayed.
sharedEss.vnmDesc: Customers benefit from electricity cost savings without owning ESS equipment — charge/discharge power from ESS installed at a third-party site is allocated and offset by time period, providing equivalent rate reduction effects.
